title: VideoHarness-SRSI: Structured Recursive Self-Improvement for Video Understanding Harness
abstract: arXiv:2610.19424v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM system capabilities depend not only on model parameters but also on the executable harnesses that organize information acquisition, tool use, reasoning, and memory. Recursive harness evolution can automate their design, but how it can reliably discover generalizable systems from limited, noisy, and repeatedly reused feedback remains unclear. We study this question in agentic video understanding, where rich multimodal evidence and coupled mechanisms make harness optimization challenging. We first introduce VHarness-BRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework that evolves video harnesses around a frozen vision-language model. Analyzing over 4,000 evolved candidates, we find it competitive with hand-engineered systems but identify three interconnected failure modes: validation overfitting, search-budget dilution, and the early-experience trap. translated_title: VideoHarness-SRSI：面向视频理解框架的结构化递归自我改进
translated_abstract: LLM系统的能力不仅取决于模型参数，还取决于组织信息获取、工具使用、推理和记忆的可执行框架。递归式框架演化可以自动化其设计，但如何从有限、嘈杂且被反复复用的反馈中可靠地发现可泛化的系统仍不清楚。我们在智能体视频理解场景中研究这一问题，其中丰富的多模态证据和相互耦合的机制使得框架优化极具挑战性。我们首先提出了VHarness-BRSI，这是一个围绕冻结的视觉语言模型对视频框架进行递归自我改进的框架。通过分析超过4,000个演化候选，我们发现其与手工设计的系统相比具有竞争力，但同时识别出三种相互关联的失败模式：验证过拟合、搜索预算稀释和早期经验陷阱。我们将这三者追溯到一个共同的根源：相同的不完善验证证据驱动……
tldr: 该论文提出结构化递归自我改进框架VideoHarness-SRSI，通过对4000多个演化候选的分析识别出验证过拟合、搜索预算稀释和早期经验陷阱三种失败模式及其共同根源，从而实现从有限且嘈杂的反馈中可靠演化出可泛化的视频理解智能体框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes VideoHarness-SRSI, a structured recursive self-improvement framework that identifies three interconnected failure modes—validation overfitting, search-budget dilution, and the early-experience trap—through analysis of over 4,000 evolved candidates, enabling reliable discovery of generalizable video understanding harnesses from limited and noisy feedback.
